
### Password reveal

type="password" adds a visibility toggle that flips the field type and reports its state through aria-pressed.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Input } from '@kryv/teal'

export function InputDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('')

  if (exampleIndex === 4) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-xs gap-4">
        <Input
          type="password"
          label="Password"
          description="Use at least 12 characters"
          autoComplete="new-password"
        />
        <Input type="password" label="Current password" autoComplete="current-password" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 3) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
        <Input
          clearable
          label="Search projects"
          description="Results update as you type"
          placeholder="Type a project name"
          value={query}
          onValueChange={setQuery}
        />
        <Input clearable label="Loading results" defaultValue="Design review" loading />
        <Input clearable label="Archived projects" placeholder="Unavailable" disabled />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
        <Input clearable size="sm" label="Filter files" placeholder="Type to filter" />
        <Input
          label="Workspace slug"
          defaultValue="not a slug"
          aria-invalid="true"
          description="Use lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes only."
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
        <Input aria-label="Email address" type="email" placeholder="name@company.com" autoComplete="email" />
        <Input aria-label="Mobile number" type="tel" inputMode="tel" placeholder="+1 555 010 2299" autoComplete="tel" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
      <Input aria-label="Search projects" placeholder="Search projects" />
      <Input aria-label="Email address" defaultValue="not-an-email" aria-invalid="true" />
      <Input aria-label="Disabled input" placeholder="Disabled input" disabled />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Control** - The native input element with Teal sizing, focus ring, and a forwarded ref.
- **Placeholder** - A short hint that disappears on entry; never a substitute for a label.
- **Invalid state** - Error styling applied through aria-invalid, either directly or from the surrounding Field.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Set type, inputMode, and autoComplete to match the value, like email or tel.
- Wrap the control in a Field so the label and messages stay associated.
- Use TextArea instead when the answer runs to multiple lines.

### Don't

- Don't use placeholder text as the only label.
- Don't disable a field the user must fix; show an error instead.
- Don't use free text for a constrained choice; use Select or RadioGroup.

## Interface

### Input

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a clear button once the field has a value. Ignored when type="password". |
| `clearLabel` | `string` | `Clear input` | Accessible label for the clear button. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the input and linked to it for assistive technology. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label rendered above the input. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Replaces the clear button with a spinner in the same trailing slot. Ignored when type="password". |
| `onClear` | `() => void` | - | Called when the clear button is pressed, after the value is cleared. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | - | Called with the new string whenever the value changes, alongside the native onChange. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| null` | `"md"` | Height and text size of the control. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to and from the control, and to the clear or visibility toggle when one is visible. |
| `Enter` + `Space` | Activates the focused clear button or password visibility toggle. |
| `Typing` | Edits the value using native text editing keys. |

- Inputs are native elements, so autofill, spellcheck, and input modes work without configuration.
- Inside a Field, aria-invalid and aria-describedby are applied automatically when the field has an error or description.
- Input label and description props render a visible label wired with htmlFor and help text linked through aria-describedby; use aria-label when there is no visible label.
- The clear action is an IconButton labeled Clear input that appears once a clearable field has a value; loading swaps it for a spinner announced with role status in the same slot, so nothing shifts between states.
- With type password, the visibility toggle flips the field between password and text and reports its state through aria-pressed; set autoComplete to new-password or current-password so password managers fill correctly.

- [Field](/modules/field)
- [TextArea](/modules/text-area)
- [Input Group](/modules/input-group)
- [Combobox](/modules/combobox)

# TextArea

Multi-line text entry with Teal sizing, invalid states, and a forwarded ref; autosize grows the field with its content.

## Usage

```js
import { TextArea } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<TextArea label="Bio" rows={4} />
<TextArea autosize label="Notes" minRows={2} maxRows={6} />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

Users enter multi-line text, and autosize should track the content height when the entry length varies.
### Avoid when

A single-line Input or a constrained set of choices is clearer.
### Behavior

Native textarea behavior is preserved, including browser validation and refs. With autosize, the height follows the content between minRows and maxRows; beyond maxRows the field scrolls instead of growing.
### Responsive

Use full width on small screens and constrain width at larger sizes.

## Examples

### Rows and states

Fixed-row textareas share the same sizing, focus, and invalid treatment as Input.

```jsx
import { TextArea } from '@kryv/teal'

export function TextAreaDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
        <TextArea
          autosize
          label="Release notes"
          description="Grows up to four rows, then scrolls."
          maxRows={4}
          defaultValue={'Shipped dark mode.\nFixed the date picker.\nPolished the empty states.'}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
        <TextArea autosize label="Bio" placeholder="Tell us about yourself" />
        <TextArea autosize label="Notes" minRows={3} maxRows={8} placeholder="Starts at three rows" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
      <TextArea label="Team update" placeholder="Write a short update for the team" />
      <TextArea
        label="Release notes"
        defaultValue="Shipped dark mode"
        aria-invalid="true"
        description="Summarize one change per line."
        rows={4}
      />
      <TextArea label="Archived notes" placeholder="Unavailable" disabled />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Autosize

TextArea with autosize grows and shrinks with its content, starting at minRows.

```jsx
import { TextArea } from '@kryv/teal'

export function TextAreaDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
        <TextArea
          autosize
          label="Release notes"
          description="Grows up to four rows, then scrolls."
          maxRows={4}
          defaultValue={'Shipped dark mode.\nFixed the date picker.\nPolished the empty states.'}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
        <TextArea autosize label="Bio" placeholder="Tell us about yourself" />
        <TextArea autosize label="Notes" minRows={3} maxRows={8} placeholder="Starts at three rows" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
      <TextArea label="Team update" placeholder="Write a short update for the team" />
      <TextArea
        label="Release notes"
        defaultValue="Shipped dark mode"
        aria-invalid="true"
        description="Summarize one change per line."
        rows={4}
      />
      <TextArea label="Archived notes" placeholder="Unavailable" disabled />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Capped growth

maxRows stops the growth and switches to scrolling, keeping long entries from pushing the form down.

```jsx
import { TextArea } from '@kryv/teal'

export function TextAreaDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
        <TextArea
          autosize
          label="Release notes"
          description="Grows up to four rows, then scrolls."
          maxRows={4}
          defaultValue={'Shipped dark mode.\nFixed the date picker.\nPolished the empty states.'}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
        <TextArea autosize label="Bio" placeholder="Tell us about yourself" />
        <TextArea autosize label="Notes" minRows={3} maxRows={8} placeholder="Starts at three rows" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
      <TextArea label="Team update" placeholder="Write a short update for the team" />
      <TextArea
        label="Release notes"
        defaultValue="Shipped dark mode"
        aria-invalid="true"
        description="Summarize one change per line."
        rows={4}
      />
      <TextArea label="Archived notes" placeholder="Unavailable" disabled />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Control** - The native textarea element with Teal sizing, focus ring, and a forwarded ref.
- **Label** - The visible label associated with the textarea, wired to any description or error text.
- **Help or error text** - Optional description or validation message linked to the field with aria-describedby.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Set rows to roughly the expected answer length.
- Set minRows on autosize fields so the empty field hints at the expected entry length.
- Set maxRows on autosize fields that can grow long, so the form below is not pushed down.

### Don't

- Don't use placeholder text as the only label.
- Don't use autosize when the layout needs a fixed, user-resizable field.
- Don't use a textarea for a constrained choice; use Select or RadioGroup.

## Interface

### TextArea

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autosize` | `boolean` | `false` | Grow and shrink with the content instead of showing a resize handle. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the textarea. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label rendered above the textarea. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used. |
| `maxRows` | `number` | - | Maximum rows shown before an autosize textarea scrolls instead of growing. |
| `minRows` | `number` | `1` | Rows shown when the content is short (autosize mode only). |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| null` | `"md"` | Text size of the control. |

## Accessibility

- TextArea label and description props render a visible label wired with htmlFor and help text linked through aria-describedby; use aria-label when there is no visible label.
- In autosize mode, TextArea suppresses visual resize because the field sizes itself; keyboard and screen-reader behavior match a standard textarea.

## Related modules

- [Input](/modules/input)
- [Field](/modules/field)
- [Mention Input](/modules/mention-input)

# Select

An accessible single-value picker with keyboard navigation, typeahead, and collision-aware positioning.

## Usage

```js
import { Select } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<Select
  aria-label="Role"
  defaultValue="viewer"
  options={[
    { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
    { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
  ]}
/>
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

Users choose one value from a known list.
### Avoid when

There are only two choices or users need to compare all options at once.
### Behavior

Radix manages keyboard navigation, typeahead, focus, and collision handling.
### Responsive

The trigger fills its parent width and the menu follows its measured width.

## Examples

### Controlled selection

Select is controlled through value and onValueChange with an options array.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Select } from '@kryv/teal'

export function SelectDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [role, setRole] = useState('viewer')

  if (exampleIndex === 3) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Select
          aria-label="Country"
          placeholder="Choose a country"
          options={[
            { value: 'au', label: 'Australia' },
            { value: 'br', label: 'Brazil' },
            { value: 'ca', label: 'Canada' },
            { value: 'de', label: 'Germany' },
            { value: 'fr', label: 'France' },
            { value: 'in', label: 'India' },
            { value: 'jp', label: 'Japan' },
            { value: 'nl', label: 'Netherlands' },
            { value: 'sg', label: 'Singapore' },
            { value: 'za', label: 'South Africa' },
            { value: 'gb', label: 'United Kingdom' },
            { value: 'us', label: 'United States' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Select
          aria-label="Assignee role"
          placeholder="Choose a role"
          options={[
            { value: 'owner', label: 'Owner' },
            { value: 'maintainer', label: 'Maintainer' },
            { value: 'contributor', label: 'Contributor' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Select
          aria-label="Support plan"
          placeholder="Choose a plan"
          options={[
            { value: 'standard', label: 'Standard' },
            { value: 'priority', label: 'Priority' },
            { value: 'dedicated', label: 'Dedicated (enterprise)', disabled: true },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <Select
        aria-label="Project role"
        value={role}
        onValueChange={setRole}
        options={[
          { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
          { value: 'editor', label: 'Editor' },
          { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Placeholder and disabled option

An uncontrolled select can show placeholder text, and individual options can be disabled.

```jsx
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Trigger** - The button that shows the current value or placeholder and opens the listbox.
- **Content** - The collision-aware listbox popup, sized to the trigger's measured width.
- **Option** - A selectable row with a check indicator on the current value; disabled options are skipped.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Order options predictably, such as alphabetically or most common first.
- Provide an aria-label when the select has no visible Field label.
- Keep option labels short so the trigger stays on one line.

### Don't

- Don't use Select for two or three options; use RadioGroup or ToggleGroup.
- Don't use it when typing should filter a long list; use Combobox.
- Don't hide critical context in the placeholder; it disappears once a value is chosen.

## Interface

### Select

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | - | Id of an element that describes the select, forwarded to the trigger. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | - | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |
| `aria-invalid` | `boolean \| "true" \| "false"` | - | Marks the trigger invalid for form validation and screen readers. |
| `id` | `string` | - | Explicit id; otherwise Field or an internal id is used. |
| `className` | `string` | - | Additional classes merged onto the trigger. |
| `options` (required) | `SelectOption[]` | - | Options rendered in the listbox. |
| `placeholder` | `ReactNode` | `Select an option` | Text shown when no value is selected. |
| `size` | `enum` | - | Size of the trigger button. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | - | - |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | - | - |
| `value` | `string` | - | - |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter` + `Space` + `Arrow Down` | Opens the listbox and highlights the selected option. |
| `Arrow Up` + `Arrow Down` | Moves the highlight between options. |
| `Home` + `End` | Highlights the first or last option. |
| `Typing` | Typeahead jumps to the first matching option. |
| `Enter` + `Tab` | Commits the highlighted option and closes the listbox. |
| `Escape` | Closes the listbox without changing the value. |

- Provide aria-label when the select has no visible label; the demo options render visible text either way.
- Disabled options are skipped during keyboard navigation and typeahead.

## Related modules

- [Combobox](/modules/combobox)
- [Radio Group](/modules/radio-group)

---

# Checkbox

Boolean and indeterminate selection with an integrated label and description; pass variant="card" for a selectable card with a title, description, and optional icon.

## Usage

```js
import { Checkbox } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<Checkbox label="Include archived projects" defaultChecked />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

Users can select independent items or a tri-state group.
### Avoid when

Changing the value should take effect immediately as a setting.
### Behavior

Checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states remain native and form-friendly. With variant="card", the checkbox renders as a single card button: clicking or pressing Space toggles it and reports the new checked state, and each card in a group tracks its own state, controlled or uncontrolled.
### Responsive

Allow supporting text to wrap beside the control. Cards fill their container width; stack them single-column on narrow screens.

## Examples

### Checked, indeterminate, and disabled

Checkbox supports a tri-state checked prop for select-all patterns.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Checkbox, Fieldset } from '@kryv/teal'
import { Bell, Mail, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react'

export function CheckboxDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [reports, setReports] = useState(['usage'])

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-3">
        <Checkbox
          variant="card"
          label="Email digest"
          description="A weekly summary of workspace activity"
          icon={<Mail />}
          defaultChecked
        />
        <Checkbox
          variant="card"
          label="Push mentions"
          description="Only when someone tags you"
          icon={<Bell />}
        />
        <Checkbox
          variant="card"
          label="SMS alerts"
          description="Unavailable on your plan"
          icon={<MessageSquare />}
          disabled
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 3) {
    return (
      <Fieldset
        className="w-full max-w-sm"
        legend="Report permissions"
        description="Each permission applies independently of the others"
      >
        <Checkbox label="View reports" description="Read every shared report" defaultChecked />
        <Checkbox label="Edit dashboards" description="Change charts and layout" />
        <Checkbox label="Manage scheduled exports" description="Create or cancel recurring exports" />
      </Fieldset>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    const all = ['usage', 'billing', 'audit']
    const parentChecked =
      reports.length === all.length ? true : reports.length === 0 ? false : 'indeterminate'
    const toggle = (id) =>
      setReports((current) =>
        current.includes(id) ? current.filter((item) => item !== id) : [...current, id],
      )
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-3">
        <Checkbox
          label="All reports"
          checked={parentChecked}
          onCheckedChange={(checked) => setReports(checked ? all : [])}
        />
        <div className="grid gap-3 pl-7">
          <Checkbox label="Usage summary" checked={reports.includes('usage')} onCheckedChange={() => toggle('usage')} />
          <Checkbox label="Billing detail" checked={reports.includes('billing')} onCheckedChange={() => toggle('billing')} />
          <Checkbox label="Audit log" checked={reports.includes('audit')} onCheckedChange={() => toggle('audit')} />
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-4">
      <Checkbox
        label="Include archived projects"
        description="Show projects that have been archived"
        defaultChecked
      />
      <Checkbox label="Select all reports" defaultChecked="indeterminate" />
      <Checkbox label="Share with external reviewers" />
      <Checkbox label="Billing locked" description="Managed by your administrator" disabled />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Select-all parent

### Bulk selection

Use indeterminate state when a table selection contains both checked and unchecked rows.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Checkbox } from '@kryv/teal'

const rows = [
  { id: 'orion', name: 'Project Orion', owner: 'Avery Chen' },
  { id: 'atlas', name: 'Project Atlas', owner: 'Morgan Lee' },
  { id: 'nova', name: 'Project Nova', owner: 'Riley Singh' },
]

export function CheckboxBulkDemo() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(['orion'])
  const allSelected = selected.length === rows.length
  const partiallySelected = selected.length > 0 && !allSelected
  function toggle(id) {
    setSelected((current) => current.includes(id) ? current.filter((value) => value !== id) : [...current, id])
  }
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xl overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-teal-outline-variant/30">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-teal-outline-variant/30 bg-teal-surface-container-high px-4 py-3">
        <Checkbox label="Select all projects" visuallyHiddenLabel checked={allSelected ? true : partiallySelected ? 'indeterminate' : false} onCheckedChange={(value) => setSelected(value ? rows.map((row) => row.id) : [])} />
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-teal-on-surface-variant">Project</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-teal-on-surface-variant">Owner</span>
      </div>
      {rows.map((row) => (
        <div key={row.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-teal-outline-variant/20 bg-teal-surface-container px-4 py-3 last:border-b-0">
          <Checkbox label={row.name} visuallyHiddenLabel checked={selected.includes(row.id)} onCheckedChange={() => toggle(row.id)} />
          <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface">{row.name}</span>
          <span className="ml-auto text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">{row.owner}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Control** - The checkbox button holding checked, unchecked, or indeterminate state.
- **Indicator** - The check or dash mark that mirrors the tri-state value.
- **Label** - Clickable text wired to the control.
- **Description** - Optional supporting text linked through aria-describedby.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Use indeterminate for a select-all parent whose children are partially checked.
- Phrase labels as positive statements so checked always means yes.
- Use Checkbox for choices that are saved on submit, not applied instantly.

### Don't

- Don't use checkboxes for mutually exclusive options; use RadioGroup.
- Don't use one for a setting that applies immediately; use Switch.
- Don't put interactive content inside the label or description.

## Interface

### Checkbox

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the label. |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | - | Optional icon rendered above the label in the card variant. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label rendered next to the checkbox. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used. In the card variant it doubles as the card title and accessible name. |
| `variant` | `enum` | `checkbox` | Visual presentation: a plain checkbox control or a selectable card. |
| `visuallyHiddenLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the label visually while keeping it available to screen readers. |
| `asChild` | `boolean` | - | Merges the component onto its child element instead of rendering the default element (Radix Slot). |
| `checked` | `boolean \| "indeterminate"` | - | Controlled checked state. Use "indeterminate" for select-all patterns. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean \| "indeterminate"` | - | Initial checked state for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: CheckedState) => void` | - | Called with the next state when the user toggles the checkbox. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | - | Prevents interaction and dims the control. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to and from the checkbox. |
| `Space` | Toggles the checkbox; indeterminate moves to checked. |
| `Space` + `Enter` | In the card variant, toggles the focused card. |

- Supports a tri-state checked value for select-all patterns, announced as "mixed" by screen readers.
- The label is clickable and the description is linked through aria-describedby.
- Inside a Field, the Field label is the only rendered label; pass label only for standalone use.
- In the card variant, the card is a button with checkbox semantics (aria-checked); the label doubles as its accessible name and the check indicator is decorative.

## Related modules

- [Switch](/modules/switch)
- [Radio Group](/modules/radio-group)
- [Field](/modules/field)

# Switch

An immediate boolean setting with explicit labeling and controlled or uncontrolled state.

## Usage

```js
import { Switch } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<Switch label="Security notifications" description="High-risk account activity" defaultChecked />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

A boolean setting takes effect immediately.
### Avoid when

The user must submit several values together as a form.
### Behavior

The label and description remain associated with the switch control.
### Responsive

Keep the control at a fixed size while the setting copy takes available width.

## Examples

### Settings

Switches apply immediately, so label them as settings rather than form fields.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Switch } from '@kryv/teal'

export function SwitchDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState(true)
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(false)

  if (exampleIndex === 3) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-3">
        <Switch label="Launch at login" size="sm" defaultChecked />
        <Switch label="Show in menu bar" size="sm" />
        <Switch label="Play sounds" size="sm" />
        <Switch label="Auto-lock" size="sm" disabled />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-teal-outline-variant/30 bg-teal-surface-container p-4">
        <Switch label="Automatic updates" description="Install new versions as they ship" defaultChecked />
        <Switch label="Background sync" description="Keep offline files current" />
        <Switch label="Usage statistics" description="Share anonymous usage data" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-5">
        <Switch
          label="Email alerts"
          description="Delivered as events happen"
          checked={alerts}
          onCheckedChange={setAlerts}
        />
        <Switch
          label="Weekly summary"
          description="Requires email alerts"
          checked={alerts && summary}
          disabled={!alerts}
          onCheckedChange={setSummary}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-5">
      <Switch
        label="Security notifications"
        description="Receive alerts for high-risk account activity"
        defaultChecked
      />
      <Switch label="Weekly digest" />
      <Switch label="Auto-deploy previews" size="sm" defaultChecked />
      <Switch label="Billing alerts" description="Managed by your administrator" disabled />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Dependent settings

A secondary switch disables itself while its prerequisite setting is off.


### Compact settings

The small size keeps dense preference lists scannable without losing the accessible label.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Switch } from '@kryv/teal'

export function SwitchDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState(true)
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState(false)

  if (exampleIndex === 3) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-3">
        <Switch label="Launch at login" size="sm" defaultChecked />
        <Switch label="Show in menu bar" size="sm" />
        <Switch label="Play sounds" size="sm" />
        <Switch label="Auto-lock" size="sm" disabled />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-teal-outline-variant/30 bg-teal-surface-container p-4">
        <Switch label="Automatic updates" description="Install new versions as they ship" defaultChecked />
        <Switch label="Background sync" description="Keep offline files current" />
        <Switch label="Usage statistics" description="Share anonymous usage data" />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-5">
        <Switch
          label="Email alerts"
          description="Delivered as events happen"
          checked={alerts}
          onCheckedChange={setAlerts}
        />
        <Switch
          label="Weekly summary"
          description="Requires email alerts"
          checked={alerts && summary}
          disabled={!alerts}
          onCheckedChange={setSummary}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-5">
      <Switch
        label="Security notifications"
        description="Receive alerts for high-risk account activity"
        defaultChecked
      />
      <Switch label="Weekly digest" />
      <Switch label="Auto-deploy previews" size="sm" defaultChecked />
      <Switch label="Billing alerts" description="Managed by your administrator" disabled />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Track** - The pill that tints with the checked state.
- **Thumb** - The knob that slides between the off and on ends of the track.
- **Label** - Text wired to the control so clicking it toggles the setting.
- **Description** - Optional supporting text linked through aria-describedby.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Use switches for settings that take effect the moment they change.
- Name the setting, not the action, so on and off stay unambiguous.
- Keep the description to one line explaining the effect.

### Don't

- Don't use a switch inside a form that submits several values together; use Checkbox.
- Don't gate a switch behind a separate Save button.
- Don't use one for hard-to-reverse actions without a confirmation step.

## Interface

### Switch

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the label. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label describing the setting the switch controls. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used. |
| `size` | `enum` | `md` | Track and thumb size. |
| `asChild` | `boolean` | - | Merges the component onto its child element instead of rendering the default element (Radix Slot). |
| `checked` | `boolean` | - | Controlled on/off state. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | - | Initial state for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | - | Called with the next state when the user toggles the switch. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | - | Prevents interaction and dims the control. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to and from the switch. |
| `Space` + `Enter` | Toggles the setting. |

- Renders role="switch" with aria-checked, so assistive technology announces it as an on/off setting.
- The label and description are wired to the control automatically.
- Inside a Field, the Field label is the only rendered label; pass label only for standalone use.

## Related modules

- [Checkbox](/modules/checkbox)
- [Toggle](/modules/toggle)
- [Field](/modules/field)

# Radio Group

A single-choice option set with an integrated label, description, and subtle borders; pass variant="card" for selectable cards with a title, description, and optional icon.

## Usage

```js
import { RadioGroup } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<RadioGroup
  label="Home region"
  defaultValue="eu"
  options={[
    { value: 'eu', label: 'Europe (Frankfurt)' },
    { value: 'us', label: 'United States (Virginia)' },
  ]}
/>
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

Users pick exactly one option from a small visible set.
### Avoid when

The list is long or needs filtering; use Select or Combobox.
### Behavior

Arrow keys move and select within the group; the label is wired through aria-labelledby. With variant="card", options render as selectable cards whose checked card holds the only tab stop; arrows wrap around and skip disabled cards, and Home/End check the first or last enabled card.
### Responsive

Switch to horizontal orientation only when labels stay on one line. In the card variant, horizontal groups wrap cards onto multiple rows on narrow screens.

## Examples

### Single choice

Keyboard arrows move and select within the group following the roving-focus pattern.

```jsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@kryv/teal'
import { Building2, Rocket, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'

export function RadioGroupDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <RadioGroup
        label="Digest frequency"
        orientation="horizontal"
        defaultValue="weekly"
        options={[
          { value: 'daily', label: 'Daily' },
          { value: 'weekly', label: 'Weekly' },
          { value: 'monthly', label: 'Monthly' },
        ]}
      />
    )
  }
  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <RadioGroup
        variant="card"
        className="w-full max-w-3xl"
        label="Choose a plan"
        orientation="horizontal"
        defaultValue="pro"
        options={[
          { value: 'starter', label: 'Starter', description: 'For side projects', icon: <Sparkles /> },
          { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro', description: 'For growing teams', icon: <Rocket /> },
          { value: 'enterprise', label: 'Enterprise', description: 'For large orgs', icon: <Building2 /> },
        ]}
      />
    )
  }
  return (
    <RadioGroup
      label="Project visibility"
      description="Choose who can open this project"
      defaultValue="team"
      options={[
        { value: 'private', label: 'Private', description: 'Only invited members can view' },
        { value: 'team', label: 'Team', description: 'Everyone in the workspace can view' },
        { value: 'public', label: 'Public', description: 'Available after launch review', disabled: true },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

### Horizontal options

A horizontal orientation suits short labels like digest frequencies.

```jsx

      label="Project visibility"
      description="Choose who can open this project"
      defaultValue="team"
      options={[
        { value: 'private', label: 'Private', description: 'Only invited members can view' },
        { value: 'team', label: 'Team', description: 'Everyone in the workspace can view' },
        { value: 'public', label: 'Public', description: 'Available after launch review', disabled: true },
      ]}

```

### Card variant

variant="card" renders each option as a selectable card with a description and optional icon, for choices that need explanation.

```jsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@kryv/teal'
import { Building2, Rocket, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'

export function RadioGroupDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  if (exampleIndex === 1) {

      <RadioGroup
        variant="card"
        className="w-full max-w-3xl"
        label="Choose a plan"
        orientation="horizontal"

        options={[

          { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro', description: 'For growing teams', icon: <Rocket /> },

      description="Choose who can open this project"

        { value: 'team', label: 'Team', description: 'Everyone in the workspace can view' },
        { value: 'public', label: 'Public', description: 'Available after launch review', disabled: true },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Group label** - The legend-style label wired to the group through aria-labelledby.
- **Item control** - The circular radio that fills when its option is selected.
- **Item label** - Clickable text naming each option.
- **Item description** - Optional per-option supporting text.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Set a defaultValue so exactly one option is always selected.
- Keep the set to about two to five options so every choice stays visible.
- Use per-option descriptions when the choices need explanation.

### Don't

- Don't use radios for long or filterable lists; use Select or Combobox.
- Don't leave all options unselected to imply a none state; add an explicit option.
- Don't switch to horizontal orientation when labels would wrap.

## Interface

### RadioGroup

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the group and linked to it for assistive technology. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label for the whole group. |
| `options` (required) | `RadioGroupOption[]` | - | Options rendered as radios inside the group. |
| `orientation` | `enum` | `vertical` | Layout direction of the options. |
| `variant` | `enum` | `radio` | Visual treatment: classic radios or selectable cards with a title, description, and optional icon. |
| `asChild` | `boolean` | - | - |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the selected radio, or the first option when none is selected. |
| `Arrow Up` + `Arrow Down` + `Arrow Left` + `Arrow Right` | Moves focus and selection between options. |
| `Space` | Selects the focused option when the group has no selection. |
| `Home` + `End` | In the card variant, checks the first or last enabled card. |

- Implements the ARIA radiogroup pattern through the Radix primitive with roving tab index.
- The group label is wired through aria-labelledby and each option keeps a clickable label.
- Disabled options stay visible but are skipped during keyboard navigation.
- In the card variant, cards expose radiogroup/radio semantics with aria-checked; arrow keys wrap around and skip disabled cards, which set aria-disabled.

## Related modules

- [Select](/modules/select)
- [Checkbox](/modules/checkbox)
- [Toggle Group](/modules/toggle-group)

# Slider

A numeric value scrubber with an optional live value readout; range mode adds a second thumb for low/high pairs.

## Usage

```js
import { Slider } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<Slider label="Notification volume" defaultValue={60} showValue />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

A value inside a known range is more natural to scrub than to type.
### Avoid when

Precision matters more than speed; pair with or use Input instead.
### Behavior

Pointer and keyboard adjust the value and showValue mirrors it live.
### Responsive

The track fills its container width, so constrain it in the layout.

## Examples

### Value selection

Pointer and keyboard both adjust the value; showValue mirrors it as text.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Slider } from '@kryv/teal'

export function SliderDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [quota, setQuota] = useState(40)

  if (exampleIndex === 3) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
        <Slider
          label="Font size"
          description="Applies to editor text"
          min={12}
          max={24}
          step={1}
          defaultValue={16}
          showValue
        />
        <Slider label="Speaker volume" min={0} max={10} step={0.5} defaultValue={4} showValue />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6">
        <Slider label="Price range" range defaultValue={[20, 80]} showValue />
        <Slider
          label="Year range"
          range
          min={2000}
          max={2030}
          step={5}
          defaultValue={[2010, 2025]}
          thumbLabels={['From year', 'To year']}
          showValue
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-4">
        <Slider label="Storage quota" description="Applies to the whole workspace" defaultValue={65} showValue />
        <Slider label="Archived projects" defaultValue={20} disabled />
      </div>
    )
  }
  return (
    <Slider
      label="Storage quota"
      description="Drag or use the arrow keys to adjust the workspace limit"
      value={quota}
      onValueChange={(value) => {
        if (typeof value === 'number') setQuota(value)
      }}
      showValue
      className="w-full max-w-md"
    />
  )
}
```

### Description and disabled

A described quota slider beside a disabled one that keeps its layout.


### Range selection

range adds a second thumb for a low/high pair; thumbLabels give each end an accessible name.


### Bounded ranges

Set min, max, and step when the meaningful range is narrower than 0–100.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'

```

## Anatomy

- **Track** - The rail that spans the full range.
- **Range** - The filled portion from the minimum up to the thumb.
- **Thumb** - The draggable handle exposing slider semantics and value attributes.
- **Value readout** - Optional live text mirror of the value, enabled with showValue.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Enable showValue when the exact number matters.
- Constrain the slider width in the layout so the track stays scannable.
- Pick min, max, and step that match meaningful stops for the value.

### Don't

- Don't use a slider for precise entry; pair it with or use NumberInput.
- Don't use one for unbounded values; sliders need a known range.
- Don't rely on track color alone to carry meaning.

## Interface

### Slider

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultValue` | `number \| [number, number]` | - | Initial value when uncontrolled: a number, or a low/high pair in range mode. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the slider and linked to it for assistive technology. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label rendered above the slider. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: number \| [number, number]) => void` | - | Called with the new value (or low/high pair in range mode) when a thumb moves. |
| `range` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders a second thumb so the slider selects a low/high pair. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the current value right-aligned above the track. |
| `thumbLabels` | `[string, string]` | `['Minimum value', 'Maximum value']` | Accessible names for the low and high thumbs (range mode only). |
| `value` | `number \| [number, number]` | - | Controlled value: a number, or a low/high pair in range mode. |
| `asChild` | `boolean` | - | - |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the thumb. |
| `Arrow Left` + `Arrow Down` | Decreases the value by one step. |
| `Arrow Right` + `Arrow Up` | Increases the value by one step. |
| `Home` + `End` | Jumps to the minimum or maximum value. |
| `Page Up` + `Page Down` | Steps the value by a larger increment. |

- Built on the Radix slider primitive, so the thumb exposes slider semantics with minimum, maximum, and current value.
- The label is wired through aria-labelledby and showValue mirrors the value as text.
- In range mode each thumb is a separate slider with its own accessible name from thumbLabels.
- Inside a Field, descriptions and errors link through aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

## Related modules

- [Number Input](/modules/number-input)
- [Rating](/modules/rating)
- [Meter](/modules/meter)

# Combobox

A filterable picker combining free text with a suggestion list; pass multiple to select several values shown as removable pills.

## Usage

```js
import { Combobox } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<Combobox
  label="Assignee"
  options={[
    { value: 'avery', label: 'Avery Chen' },
    { value: 'morgan', label: 'Morgan Reyes' },
  ]}
/>
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

Users choose one value from a list long enough to need filtering; pass multiple to pick several values.
### Avoid when

The list is short; use Select, or the value is free text; use Input.
### Behavior

Typing filters, arrows highlight, Enter selects, Escape preserves the current value. With multiple, options toggle without closing and pills remove individual values.
### Responsive

The suggestion list matches the field width and collision-handles vertically; in multiple mode pills wrap inside the control as values accumulate.

## Examples

### Filter and select

Type to filter, arrows to highlight, Enter to select; Escape keeps the current value.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Combobox } from '@kryv/teal'

export function ComboboxDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState('mira')
  const [project, setProject] = useState('')
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState(['editor'])

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Combobox
          multiple
          label="Project roles"
          placeholder="Select roles…"
          value={roles}
          onValueChange={setRoles}
          options={[
            { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
            { value: 'editor', label: 'Editor' },
            { value: 'reviewer', label: 'Reviewer' },
            { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Combobox
          label="Move to project"
          description="Start typing to filter your projects"
          placeholder="Search projects…"
          emptyMessage="No projects match"
          value={project}
          onValueChange={setProject}
          options={[
            { value: 'atlas', label: 'Atlas redesign' },
            { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing migration' },
            { value: 'docs', label: 'Docs overhaul' },
            { value: 'mobile', label: 'Mobile app', disabled: true },
            { value: 'onboarding', label: 'Onboarding revamp' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <Combobox
        label="Assignee"
        placeholder="Search people…"
        value={assignee}
        onValueChange={setAssignee}
        options={[
          { value: 'mira', label: 'Mira Chen' },
          { value: 'jonas', label: 'Jonas Weber' },
          { value: 'priya', label: 'Priya Nair' },
          { value: 'sam', label: 'Sam Ortiz' },
          { value: 'lena', label: 'Lena Fischer' },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Filter with empty state

A project picker with a disabled option and a custom message when nothing matches.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Combobox } from '@kryv/teal'

export function ComboboxDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState('mira')
  const [project, setProject] = useState('')
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState(['editor'])

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Combobox
          multiple
          label="Project roles"
          placeholder="Select roles…"
          value={roles}
          onValueChange={setRoles}
          options={[
            { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
            { value: 'editor', label: 'Editor' },
            { value: 'reviewer', label: 'Reviewer' },
            { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Combobox
          label="Move to project"
          description="Start typing to filter your projects"
          placeholder="Search projects…"
          emptyMessage="No projects match"
          value={project}
          onValueChange={setProject}
          options={[
            { value: 'atlas', label: 'Atlas redesign' },
            { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing migration' },
            { value: 'docs', label: 'Docs overhaul' },
            { value: 'mobile', label: 'Mobile app', disabled: true },
            { value: 'onboarding', label: 'Onboarding revamp' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <Combobox
        label="Assignee"
        placeholder="Search people…"
        value={assignee}
        onValueChange={setAssignee}
        options={[
          { value: 'mira', label: 'Mira Chen' },
          { value: 'jonas', label: 'Jonas Weber' },
          { value: 'priya', label: 'Priya Nair' },
          { value: 'sam', label: 'Sam Ortiz' },
          { value: 'lena', label: 'Lena Fischer' },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Multiple values

With multiple, options toggle without closing and selected values render as removable pills.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { Combobox } from '@kryv/teal'

export function ComboboxDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState('mira')
  const [project, setProject] = useState('')
  const [roles, setRoles] = useState(['editor'])

  if (exampleIndex === 2) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Combobox
          multiple
          label="Project roles"
          placeholder="Select roles…"
          value={roles}
          onValueChange={setRoles}
          options={[
            { value: 'admin', label: 'Administrator' },
            { value: 'editor', label: 'Editor' },
            { value: 'reviewer', label: 'Reviewer' },
            { value: 'viewer', label: 'Viewer' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <Combobox
          label="Move to project"
          description="Start typing to filter your projects"
          placeholder="Search projects…"
          emptyMessage="No projects match"
          value={project}
          onValueChange={setProject}
          options={[
            { value: 'atlas', label: 'Atlas redesign' },
            { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing migration' },
            { value: 'docs', label: 'Docs overhaul' },
            { value: 'mobile', label: 'Mobile app', disabled: true },
            { value: 'onboarding', label: 'Onboarding revamp' },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <Combobox
        label="Assignee"
        placeholder="Search people…"
        value={assignee}
        onValueChange={setAssignee}
        options={[
          { value: 'mira', label: 'Mira Chen' },
          { value: 'jonas', label: 'Jonas Weber' },
          { value: 'priya', label: 'Priya Nair' },
          { value: 'sam', label: 'Sam Ortiz' },
          { value: 'lena', label: 'Lena Fischer' },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Input** - The text field with combobox semantics that filters the list as you type.
- **Listbox** - The suggestion popup matched to the field width.
- **Option** - A filterable row with a check mark on the selected value.
- **Empty message** - The text shown when no option matches the filter.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Use Combobox when the list is long enough to need filtering.
- Write an emptyMessage that suggests what to try next.
- Keep the committed value readable as the input text.

### Don't

- Don't use it for short lists; use Select.
- Don't treat unmatched text as a value; use TagsInput for free entry.
- Don't clear the current value on Escape; it should restore, not wipe.

## Interface

### Combobox

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | - | - |
| `aria-label` | `string` | - | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |
| `aria-invalid` | `boolean \| "true" \| "false"` | - | Marks the input invalid for form validation and screen readers. |
| `id` | `string` | - | Explicit id; otherwise Field or an internal id is used. |
| `className` | `string` | - | - |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| string[]` | - | Initial selected value when uncontrolled; an array in multiple mode. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the input. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents interaction with the input. |
| `emptyMessage` | `ReactNode` | `No matches` | Message shown when no option matches the typed text. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label rendered above the input. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allows selecting several values, rendered as removable chips. |
| `onValueChange` | `((value: string) => void) \| ((value: string[]) => void)` | - | Called with the value of the selected option; the full list of values in multiple mode. |
| `options` (required) | `ComboboxOption[]` | - | Options rendered in the filtered listbox. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `Select…` | Text shown when no value is selected. |
| `required` | `boolean` | - | Marks the input as required. |
| `value` | `string \| string[]` | - | Controlled selected value; an array in multiple mode. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Filters the option list and opens the listbox. |
| `Arrow Down` + `Arrow Up` | Moves the highlight through the filtered options. |
| `Enter` | Selects the highlighted option and closes the listbox. |
| `Escape` | Closes the listbox without changing the committed value. |
| `Enter` + `Space` + `Arrow Down` | In multiple mode, opens the listbox from the control. |
| `Tab` | In multiple mode, moves focus between the control, pill remove buttons, and the open listbox. |

- The input renders the combobox role with aria-autocomplete list and aria-activedescendant for the highlighted option.
- Options render option roles with aria-selected; disabled options cannot be chosen.
- The empty message appears inside the listbox when no option matches the filter.
- In multiple mode the control is a combobox-role trigger hosting selected pills, and the listbox popup is aria-multiselectable; every pill has a remove button labeled Remove plus the option name.

## Related modules

- [Select](/modules/select)
- [Mention Input](/modules/mention-input)
- [Input](/modules/input)

# Number Input

A numeric field with stepper buttons and min/max clamping.

## Usage

```js
import { NumberInput } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<NumberInput label="Seats" defaultValue={4} min={1} max={12} />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

A numeric value benefits from quick stepping.
### Avoid when

The value is an identifier, not a quantity; use Input.
### Behavior

Steppers use 24px touch targets and blur clamps to min/max; empty means undefined.
### Responsive

The field fills its container; constrain it in the form layout.

## Examples

### Steppers and bounds

Steppers disable at the bounds; typing re-clamps on blur.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { NumberInput } from '@kryv/teal'

export function NumberInputDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [teamSize, setTeamSize] = useState(4)
  const [velocity, setVelocity] = useState(20)

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <NumberInput
          label="Sprint velocity"
          description="Story points, in steps of 5 (0–100)"
          value={velocity}
          onValueChange={setVelocity}
          min={0}
          max={100}
          step={5}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <NumberInput
        label="Team size"
        description="How many people join this workspace"
        value={teamSize}
        onValueChange={setTeamSize}
        min={1}
        max={20}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Custom step

A step of 5 with 0–100 bounds for story-point entry.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { NumberInput } from '@kryv/teal'

export function NumberInputDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [teamSize, setTeamSize] = useState(4)
  const [velocity, setVelocity] = useState(20)

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
        <NumberInput
          label="Sprint velocity"
          description="Story points, in steps of 5 (0–100)"
          value={velocity}
          onValueChange={setVelocity}
          min={0}
          max={100}
          step={5}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <NumberInput
        label="Team size"
        description="How many people join this workspace"
        value={teamSize}
        onValueChange={setTeamSize}
        min={1}
        max={20}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Input** - The numeric text field that re-clamps to the bounds on blur.
- **Steppers** - Increment and decrement buttons that step the value and disable at min and max.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Set min and max so clamping matches the business rule.
- Choose a step that matches how people think, like 5 for story points.
- Treat an empty field as undefined in the caller, not as zero.

### Don't

- Don't use it for identifiers like codes or phone numbers; use Input.
- Don't use it when the value needs currency formatting; use CurrencyInput.
- Don't hide the bounds; state them in the description.

## Interface

### NumberInput

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | - | - |
| `aria-label` | `string` | - | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |
| `aria-invalid` | `boolean \| "true" \| "false"` | - | Marks the input invalid for form validation and screen readers. |
| `className` | `string` | - | - |
| `defaultValue` | `number` | - | Initial value when uncontrolled. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the input. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | - | Prevents interaction with the input. |
| `id` | `string` | - | Explicit id; otherwise Field or an internal id is used. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label rendered above the input. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used. |
| `max` | `number` | - | Largest allowed value; stepper clamps to it. |
| `min` | `number` | - | Smallest allowed value; stepper clamps to it. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: number) => void` | - | Called with the parsed number, or undefined when the field is emptied. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | - | Text shown when the field is empty. |
| `required` | `boolean` | - | Marks the input as required. |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | Amount added or removed by the stepper buttons. |
| `value` | `number` | - | Controlled value. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus through the field and the stepper buttons. |
| `Enter` + `Space` | Activates the focused stepper to increment or decrement. |
| `Typing` | Edits the value directly; the field re-clamps on blur. |

- Steppers are labeled Increment and Decrement and disable at the min and max bounds.
- An empty field reports undefined rather than zero.
- Inside a Field, descriptions and errors link through aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

- [Slider](/modules/slider)

# File Upload

A drag-and-drop zone with a browse action and a removable file list.

## Usage

```js
import { FileUpload } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<FileUpload label="Attachments" multiple onFilesAdded={(files) => undefined} />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

Users attach files to a form.
### Avoid when

A single URL or text reference suffices; use Input.
### Behavior

Drag-over highlights the zone; the list mirrors the caller-owned value.
### Responsive

The zone fills its container and the file list wraps below.

## Examples

### Drop or browse

Drag-over highlights the zone; files list with sizes and remove actions.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { FileUpload } from '@kryv/teal'

export function FileUploadDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState([{ name: 'roadmap-q3.pdf', size: 482_304 }])

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <FileUpload
          label="Project attachments"
          description="Design docs, spreadsheets, or archives"
          multiple
          value={files}
          onValueChange={setFiles}
          onFilesAdded={(added) => console.log('Added', added.map((file) => file.name))}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md">
      <FileUpload label="Profile photo" description="PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB" accept="image/*" />
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Multiple attachments

A controlled multi-file zone seeded with an existing file and a removal action.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { FileUpload } from '@kryv/teal'

export function FileUploadDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState([{ name: 'roadmap-q3.pdf', size: 482_304 }])

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <FileUpload
          label="Project attachments"
          description="Design docs, spreadsheets, or archives"
          multiple
          value={files}
          onValueChange={setFiles}
          onFilesAdded={(added) => console.log('Added', added.map((file) => file.name))}
        />
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md">
      <FileUpload label="Profile photo" description="PNG or JPG, up to 5 MB" accept="image/*" />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Drop zone** - The drag target that highlights on drag-over and holds the browse action.
- **Browse action** - The explicit button that opens the file picker without drag-and-drop.
- **File list** - Rows with the name, size, and a remove action per file.

## Do and don't

### Do

- State accepted types and size limits in the description.
- Mirror the caller-owned value so removals stay in sync.
- Use accept to narrow the picker, then validate again on the server.

### Don't

- Don't auto-upload on selection without telling the user.
- Don't use it for a single text reference; use Input.
- Don't swallow rejected files silently; surface why a file was refused.

## Interface

### FileUpload

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | - | - |
| `aria-invalid` | `boolean \| "true" \| "false"` | - | Marks the control invalid for form validation and screen readers. |
| `id` | `string` | - | Explicit id; otherwise Field or an internal id is used. |
| `accept` | `string` | - | Comma-separated list of accepted file types, forwarded to the file input. |
| `className` | `string` | - | - |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Supporting text rendered below the dropzone. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents adding or removing files. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Visible label rendered above the dropzone. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Allows selecting more than one file at a time. |
| `onFilesAdded` | `(files: File[]) => void` | - | Called with the raw File objects each time files are added. |
| `onValueChange` | `(files: FileUploadFile[]) => void` | - | Called with the next file list whenever files are added or removed. |
| `required` | `boolean` | - | Marks the control as required. |
| `value` | `FileUploadFile[]` | - | Controlled file list. When omitted the component tracks the list internally. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves focus through the browse button and each file remove button. |
| `Enter` + `Space` | Opens the file picker from the browse button, or removes a file from its row. |

- The native file input is visually hidden; the visible Browse button opens it and the label still points at the input.
- File rows are list items with the name, formatted size, and an IconButton labeled Remove plus the file name.
- The upload and file icons are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

## Related modules

- [Upload Progress](/modules/upload-progress)
- [Input](/modules/input)
- [Field](/modules/field)
- [Form](/modules/form)

# PIN Input

A segmented one-time code field with per-cell navigation, paste support, and masking.

## Usage

```js
import { PinInput } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<PinInput label="Verification code" length={6} onComplete={(code) => undefined} />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

The user enters a fixed-length numeric code.
### Avoid when

The value is free-form text; use Input.
### Behavior

Typing, Backspace, arrows, and paste move between cells; onComplete fires when full.
### Responsive

Cells keep a fixed tap size; reduce length on narrow screens.

## Examples

### One-time code

Typing advances to the next cell, Backspace retreats, and paste fills from the focused cell.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { PinInput } from '@kryv/teal'

export function PinInputDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState('')

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <PinInput label="Security PIN" length={4} masked />
        <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">Masked cells hide the code like a password.</span>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <PinInput label="Verification code" length={6} onComplete={setCompleted} />
      <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">
        {completed ? `Completed code: ${completed}` : 'Type or paste a six-digit code.'}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Masked PIN

A four-digit masked entry for codes that should stay hidden.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { PinInput } from '@kryv/teal'

export function PinInputDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState('')

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <PinInput label="Security PIN" length={4} masked />
        <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">Masked cells hide the code like a password.</span>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <PinInput label="Verification code" length={6} onComplete={setCompleted} />
      <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">
        {completed ? `Completed code: ${completed}` : 'Type or paste a six-digit code.'}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Group** - The labeled container with group semantics wrapping the cells.
- **Cells** - One single-character input per digit, each labeled by its position.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Set length to the code your service actually issues.
- Handle onComplete to submit as soon as the last digit lands.
- Use masked for PINs that should not linger on screen.

### Don't

- Don't use it for free-form codes; use Input.
- Don't split long secrets into cells; keep it for short numeric codes.
- Don't rely on per-cell placeholders as labels; each cell is already labeled by position.

## Interface

### PinInput

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | - | Initial code when uncontrolled. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents interaction with every cell. |
| `label` | `string` | `One-time code` | Accessible name for the cell group. |
| `length` | `number` | `6` | Number of cells; each cell holds one digit. |
| `masked` | `boolean` | `false` | Masks each cell like a password field. |
| `onChange` | `(code: string) => void` | - | Called with the current code (may contain gaps) after every edit. |
| `onComplete` | `(code: string) => void` | - | Called with the full code once every cell is filled. |
| `value` | `string` | - | Controlled code value. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Enters a digit and advances to the next cell. |
| `Backspace` | Clears the cell, or retreats to the previous cell when empty. |
| `Arrow Left` + `Arrow Right` | Moves focus between cells without changing digits. |
| `Paste` | Fills the cells from the focused position. |

- The cells sit in a group named by the field label; each cell is labeled Digit N of the total length.
- Masked mode hides the entered digits like a password field.
- onComplete fires as soon as every cell is filled.

## Related modules

- [Input](/modules/input)
- [Form](/modules/form)

# Tags Input

A token entry field that turns typed text into removable chips.

## Usage

```js
import { TagsInput } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
const [tags, setTags] = useState(['design'])

<TagsInput label="Add label" value={tags} onChange={setTags} placeholder="Add a label…" />
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

A field collects an open-ended list of short tokens.
### Avoid when

Values come from a fixed set; use Combobox with multiple.
### Behavior

Enter or comma commits; duplicates are ignored and chips remove individually.
### Responsive

Chips wrap inside the field as the list grows.

## Examples

### Token entry

Enter or comma commits a tag; Backspace on an empty draft removes the last one.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { TagsInput } from '@kryv/teal'

export function TagsInputDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState(['design', 'accessibility'])
  const [reviewers, setReviewers] = useState(['avery'])

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-2">
        <TagsInput label="Add reviewer" value={reviewers} onChange={setReviewers} max={3} placeholder="Add a reviewer…" />
        <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">At most three reviewers are allowed.</span>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-2">
      <TagsInput label="Add label" value={tags} onChange={setTags} placeholder="Add a label…" />
      <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">Press Enter or comma to add; Backspace removes the last tag.</span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Capped list

max limits the reviewer list to three entries and the cap is stated nearby.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { TagsInput } from '@kryv/teal'

export function TagsInputDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  const [tags, setTags] = useState(['design', 'accessibility'])
  const [reviewers, setReviewers] = useState(['avery'])

  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-2">
        <TagsInput label="Add reviewer" value={reviewers} onChange={setReviewers} max={3} placeholder="Add a reviewer…" />
        <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">At most three reviewers are allowed.</span>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-2">
      <TagsInput label="Add label" value={tags} onChange={setTags} placeholder="Add a label…" />
      <span className="text-sm text-teal-on-surface-variant">Press Enter or comma to add; Backspace removes the last tag.</span>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Field** - The container hosting the committed chips and the draft input.
- **Chips** - Committed tokens with individual remove actions.
- **Draft input** - The inline text field where the next tag is typed.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Commit on Enter and comma so both habits work.
- Set max when the backend caps the list, and say so nearby.
- Keep tokens to one or two words so chips stay scannable.

### Don't

- Don't use it for a fixed option set; use Combobox with multiple.
- Don't commit empty or whitespace-only tags.
- Don't expect fuzzy dedupe; exact duplicates are ignored, so normalize case before commit if needed.

## Interface

### TagsInput

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents adding or removing tags. |
| `label` | `string` | `Add tag` | Accessible name for the text entry. |
| `max` | `number` | - | Maximum number of tags; further entries are ignored. |
| `onChange` | `(tags: string[]) => void` | - | Called with the next tag list after every add or remove. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | - | Placeholder shown in the text entry. |
| `value` (required) | `string[]` | - | Current tags. |

## Accessibility

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter` + `,` | Commits the draft as a new tag. |
| `Backspace` | Removes the last tag when the draft is empty. |
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the chip remove buttons and out of the field. |

- Chips mirror the caller-owned value and each carries a labeled remove action.
- Duplicate tags are ignored instead of being committed twice.
- The max prop stops new entries once the cap is reached.

## Related modules

- [Chip](/modules/chip)
- [Input](/modules/input)
- [Combobox](/modules/combobox)

# Input Group

An input joined with leading or trailing addons such as protocols and units.

## Usage

```js
import { InputGroup, InputAddon, Input } from '@kryv/teal'
```

```jsx
<InputGroup>
  <InputAddon position="leading">https://</InputAddon>
  <Input aria-label="Domain" placeholder="workspace.example" />
</InputGroup>
```

## Design guidance

### Use when

An input needs a fixed prefix or suffix such as a protocol or unit.
### Avoid when

The accessory is interactive; use separate controls instead.
### Behavior

The group owns the border and focus ring, so the whole box highlights as one control.
### Responsive

Addons stay fixed width while the input flexes.

## Examples

### Addons

The group squares the joined input corners automatically on the attached side.

```jsx
import { Input, InputAddon, InputGroup } from '@kryv/teal'

export function InputGroupDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-xs gap-4">
        <InputGroup>
          <Input aria-label="Storage quota" defaultValue="50" />
          <InputAddon position="trailing">GB</InputAddon>
        </InputGroup>
        <InputGroup>
          <Input aria-label="Hourly rate" defaultValue="120" />
          <InputAddon position="trailing">USD/h</InputAddon>
        </InputGroup>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <InputGroup>
        <InputAddon position="leading">https://</InputAddon>
        <Input aria-label="Workspace domain" placeholder="workspace.example" />
      </InputGroup>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### Trailing units

Trailing addons carry units like GB or USD/h beside the value.

```jsx
import { Input, InputAddon, InputGroup } from '@kryv/teal'

export function InputGroupDemo({ exampleIndex = 0 }) {
  if (exampleIndex === 1) {
    return (
      <div className="grid w-full max-w-xs gap-4">
        <InputGroup>
          <Input aria-label="Storage quota" defaultValue="50" />
          <InputAddon position="trailing">GB</InputAddon>
        </InputGroup>
        <InputGroup>
          <Input aria-label="Hourly rate" defaultValue="120" />
          <InputAddon position="trailing">USD/h</InputAddon>
        </InputGroup>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <InputGroup>
        <InputAddon position="leading">https://</InputAddon>
        <Input aria-label="Workspace domain" placeholder="workspace.example" />
      </InputGroup>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

- **Group** - The wrapper that owns the border and focus ring so the box reads as one control.
- **Addon** - Fixed leading or trailing content such as a protocol or unit.
- **Input** - The flexing field whose joined corners square automatically.

## Do and don't

### Do

- Use addons for static text like https://, units, or currency codes.
- Give the input an aria-label, since addon text is presentational context.
- Keep addon text to a few characters so the field keeps most of the width.

### Don't

- Don't put interactive controls in an addon; compose separate controls instead.
- Don't use an addon as a substitute for a real label.
- Don't join more than one input into a group.

## Interface

### InputGroup

_This module forwards native element properties._

### InputAddon

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `position` (required) | `enum` | - | Which end of the input the addon attaches to. |

## Accessibility

- Addons are presentational text; give the input an aria-label or wrap the group in a Field so the control stays named.
- The group owns the border and focus ring, so the joined control reads as one box.
- Addons are not focusable; place interactive accessories next to the group instead.
